name: Minor in Computer Science
subtitle: 🚧 Study plan coming soon · 22 CH
bio: 22 credit hours: 16 CH compulsory (Object-Oriented Programming, Data Structures, Database Management Systems, Web Application and Technology, Software Engineering) plus 6 CH of third/fourth-year Computer Science electives. 🚧 Per-course credit hours weren't given, so the interactive plan isn't available yet.
